key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize building battery control under variable PV generation and electricity prices while making the policy understandable to operators.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports cost-efficient, transparent energy management for PV-equipped residential buildings, which is important for practical deployment of smart building control systems.
method: Train on-policy and off-policy DRL agents for building energy management.
Use an expanded state space with demand, PV, battery, state of charge, weather, tariffs, calendars, and forecasts.
Apply post-hoc explanation methods to interpret learned control policies.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates synthetic data and real-world Living Lab Energy Campus data, finding A2C and PPO outperform off-policy methods in cumulative reward and policy stability.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on forecast quality and site-specific building dynamics, so transfer to other buildings should be validated carefully.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
